SELECT ca.title AS title, c.duty AS duty, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, c.input_date AS inputDate, c.calender_no AS calenderNo FROM CALENDERLOG c LEFT JOIN calender ca on c.calender_no = ca.calender_no LEFT JOIN CALENDERCONNECTION cn on ca.calender_no = cn.calender_no LEFT JOIN USERS u on cn.user_no = u.user_no
AND u.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
AND l.INPUT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND l.INPUT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND t.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%'
AND l.DUTY LIKE '%' || #{duty} || '%'
AND u.USER_NAME = #{userName, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler}
ORDER BY l.INPUT_DATE DESC
SELECT ca.title, ca.start_date AS startDate, ca.end_date AS endDate FROM CALENDERLOG c LEFT JOIN calender ca on c.calender_no = ca.calender_no WHERE log_no = #{logNo}
